resources.string: Selects the background source used outside the dynamic lens.
Controls blur applied to the full captured background.
Adjusts displacement between red and blue in the captured image.

Default mode 0 keeps the original edge outside Display P3. Notifications on Display P3 automatically use additive mode 3 with 1.5x RGB light; disable with debug.oulg.p3edgecompat=0. Manual diagnostic modes: 1 uses premultiplied normal blending; 2 adds light at 1.0x; 3 at 1.5x; 4 at 1.4x. Saved values are preserved.
Adjusts the space between the header and title of expanded notifications.
Adapts the shade clock, date, and carrier text to the background.
Selects the dynamic lens material used on pop-ups.
Sets the pop-up capture rate in capture mode.
Sets the lock screen capture rate when capture is needed.
Scales only treated notification glyphs inside their existing slots in the shade, heads-up and lock screen. Unmodified icons keep their native size.
Used over dark or colored notification backgrounds in two-color mode.
Used when notification icon color is set to Fixed.
Original adaptive black/white, one fixed color, or a separate color for light and colored notification backgrounds.
Used over light notification backgrounds in two-color mode.
Controls which notification app icons are converted to a background-free monochrome glyph. System and service icons are treated by default; user-selected icon packs are preserved.
Matches monochrome notification icons to the text color.
Sets the refractive index used by the physical model.
Selects where lock screen blur is drawn when the dynamic lens is active.
Controls lock screen card blur. Automatic follows pop-up blur or blur under the dynamic lens.
Adjusts the translucent white layer in dark lock screen glass.
Adjusts the black fill inside dark lock screen cards.
Adjusts the corner highlight on lock screen cards.
Adjusts edge refraction on lock screen cards when the dynamic lens is active.

Fine-tunes only the Java outer hairline of lock screen notifications; default 0.80x. The SurfaceFlinger structural rim and Now Bar are unchanged; the final perceived thickness also depends on that native rim.
Selects the dynamic lens material used on lock screen cards.
Adjusts the outline of lock screen cards.

KG notifications reuse the Now Bar\'s Java optical shader. Keep Fixed rim (sf.kgfixedrim=1) enabled: the combined appearance was approved on DZIF; disabling the structural rim flattened the glass. Does not change body tone, refraction, or blur. On is the approved default.
Allows touch-triggered window blur ramps on the stationary lock screen.
Adjusts the displacement of the pop-up lens strip relative to the bevel.
Selects which touches hide the lens strip during movement.
Sets the maximum age of a capture used by the lens strip.
Sets how long the lens strip stays hidden after a touch or gesture.
Sets the extra delay after a gesture that may open another app.
Adjusts the edge shadow on light glass.
Adjusts light glass opacity on pop-ups and lock screen cards.
Adjusts the outline of light glass over light backgrounds.
Changes the base color of light glass.
Enables the standard glass material drawn by the module.
Adjusts the translucent white layer in dark pop-up glass.
Adjusts the black fill over dark pop-up glass.
Adjusts the highlight in the upper-left corner of pop-ups.
Shows a captured refracted edge strip on pop-ups while the background is still.
Adjusts overall edge lighting for standard glass, including the outline and highlights.
Controls the standard glass blur in pop-ups. Lock screen cards follow this value when their blur is automatic.
Adjusts the pop-up outline, together with the edge intensity setting.
Controls the standard glass blur inside each notification shade card.
Adjusts the highlight that fades from the top of each card.
Adjusts artwork opacity over glass in the notification shade and Live Updates media card. Native artwork restores its original appearance without turning off glass.
Applies the shade tone to collapsed group rows on their first draw.
Limits background blur behind notifications and Quick Settings. Native lets Samsung choose the blur.
Adjusts the color and opacity of the shade background independently of the cards.
Darkens the shade background over light apps in dark theme.
Restores Samsung’s native gray color adjustment over the shade background.
Logs hook timing for diagnostics; measuring has a performance cost.
Controls blur in the lock screen notification icon summary.
Applies glass to the lock screen notification icon summary.

Fine-tunes only the Java outer hairline light of heads-up notifications; default 1.30x. Does not alter the line\'s width, inner reflections, Fresnel, blur, or Now Bar. The native compositor\'s light is not changed.
Stabilizes pop-up contrast by confirming background changes before switching tone.
Measures the background to adjust contrast on pop-ups.
Selects the refraction model for captured backgrounds.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; it no longer changes disc appearance.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; it no longer changes capsule appearance.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; it no longer changes capsule appearance.
Adjusts capsule outline brightness over dark or colored backgrounds.
Controls background blur sampled by the dynamic lens at capsule edges.
Adjusts the thickness of the slider fill without changing brightness or volume.
Adjusts the additional highlight at the upper-left corner of capsules.
Hides the background and border of identified off tile discs while keeping their icons.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; it no longer changes off discs.
Changes the capsule tint color over light backgrounds.
Adjusts capsule tint over light backgrounds.
Changes the RGBA color of the opacity layer over light backgrounds.
Adjusts capsule glass opacity over light backgrounds without changing edge intensity.
Adjusts capsule edge lighting over light backgrounds.
Adjusts capsule outline brightness over light backgrounds.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; current styles use adaptive ink.
Adjusts brightness and volume slider capsule thickness without changing the touch area.
Changes the color and opacity of slider fill over dark or colored backgrounds.
Changes the color and opacity of slider fill over light backgrounds.
Enables the custom tile palette over dark or colored backgrounds.
Changes the color of off tile discs over dark or colored backgrounds.
Adjusts the opacity of off tile discs over dark or colored backgrounds.
Changes monochrome off-tile icon color when the colored palette is enabled.
Changes the color of on tile discs over dark or colored backgrounds.
Changes monochrome on-tile icon color when the colored palette is enabled.
Enables custom tile disc contrast over light backgrounds.
Changes the color of off tile discs over light backgrounds.
Adjusts the opacity of off tile discs over light backgrounds.
Changes monochrome off-tile icon color over light backgrounds.
Changes the color of on tile discs over light backgrounds.
Changes monochrome on-tile icon color over light backgrounds.
Retired setting kept for saved profiles; it has no drawn surface.
Multiplies displacement in the physical refraction model.
Controls blur on the captured edge strip.
Sets the capture rate for the pop-up lens strip.
Adjusts saturation of the captured background.
Adjusts the opacity of the color applied by system blur.
Selects the color curve used by system blur; support varies by firmware.
Controls system blur on cards without the standard glass or a lens.
Controls system blur under the dynamic lens. Less blur leaves more detail for refraction.
Selects the geometry of the system blur region.
Reports the Clear Glass modes of the last compiled compositor program. Absent means unknown; it does not confirm that a card was drawn with Clear Glass.
Adjusts blur at the center of pop-ups. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Diagnostic mode: 0 off, 1 magenta/cyan for rewritten shaders, 2 green map of local edge luminance on lock screen notifications. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts pop-up edge blur and its transition toward the center. Changes apply after userspace restarts.

Adjusts the width over which lock screen edge blur and refraction grow. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Multiplies the shader blur across lock screen cards without changing base blur. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts how quickly blur increases across the lock screen edge transition. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts diffuse refraction across lock screen cards. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Experimental Clear Glass parameter; registered for the compositor contract, not yet a control in the app. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the cool tint of lock screen glass. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts blur in the center of lock screen cards. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Limits the effective inner blur radius on the lock screen. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Darkens the center of lock screen cards. Changes apply after userspace restarts.

Sets the maximum reach (px) of the faint inward light veil on lock screen cards. The bright, background-reactive rim stays narrow and unaffected by this setting. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts blur at the edges of lock screen cards. Changes apply after userspace restarts.

On (default): preserve the outline and reflections that give the lens depth. Off: diagnostic only; removing all three makes the lock-screen card visually flat. Blur radii do not change. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts how strongly the lock screen background brightness is made uniform. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Limits the strength of lock screen brightness uniformity. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the width of the lock screen lens rim glow. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the transition between the glass edge and center. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the target brightness for lock screen uniformity. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts light entering lock screen card edges from the background. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the dynamic lens outline on the lock screen. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the depth at which lock screen inner blur reaches full strength. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Multiplies edge and center refraction on lock screen cards. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts reflection in the lock screen lens rim. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts color saturation through lock screen glass. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the specular highlight on lock screen edges. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the samples per pixel for lock screen blur. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the direction of the light illuminating the lock screen edge. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts the highlight curve through lock screen glass. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Reports whether shader rewriting is disabled for the current userspace session.
Reports the version marker written by the compositor library; it does not confirm the lens is active.
Adjusts the refracted background visible at Quick Settings capsule edges. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts how far light from a bright background enters a Quick Settings capsule. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts background refraction near Quick Settings capsule edges. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts background light entering Quick Settings capsule edges. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the depth at which pop-up inner blur reaches full strength. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the maximum brightness under light text in the shade lens tone map. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the minimum brightness under dark text in the shade lens tone map. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts light entering shade card edges from the background. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Sets the samples per pixel for inner pop-up blur; higher values cost more GPU time. Changes apply after userspace restarts.
Adjusts edge refraction on pop-ups when the dynamic lens is active.
Indicates whether the injector enabled the dynamic lens.
Gives each expanded shade card its own blur instead of relying only on the panel blur.
Selects where shade card blur is drawn.
Sets the background luminance threshold for darkening behind light text.
Adjusts dark glass opacity on notification shade cards.
Sets the opacity below which card blur is removed while the shade closes.
Adjusts the corner highlight on notification shade cards.
Sets the background luminance threshold for lightening behind dark text.
Adjusts light glass opacity on notification shade cards.
Fine-tunes only the outer hairline light on notification shade cards; default 1.30x. Does not change the fill, internal highlights, blur, or Now Bar.
Measures the background behind each card instead of the whole screen.
Adjusts the fallback contrast veil while a shade card is resized.
Selects how notification shade cards protect text contrast.
Used over dark or colored backgrounds when the status bar uses two custom colors.
Used when status bar color is set to Fixed.
Scales only eligible treated notification glyphs in the status bar; preserves the other icons and the native slot width.
Keep Samsung\'s adaptive status-bar colors by default, use one fixed color, or choose two colors by background. Coverage depends on the One UI dark receiver classes.
Used over light backgrounds when the status bar uses two custom colors.

Zero preserves Samsung\'s maximum. Other values use One UI 9\'s overflow limit and status bar ViewModel if present. Restart System UI after changing the cap to recreate the ViewModel. Available width still limits what fits.
Sets the background luminance above which a card switches to light glass.
Sets the background luminance below which a card switches to dark glass.
Adapts the glass and text colors to the background.
Adjusts the opacity of the veil over the captured background.
Logs window and view trees for diagnostics and can generate extensive logs.
Limits the contrast veil calculated from the background.
